action_items: OPTIONAL/MINOR: Add a data-testid (e.g. 'bamburgh-gallery') to the gallery <section> in /app/frontend/src/pages/BamburghPage.jsx (line 102) to enable explicit DOM-order test assertions. Order is currently correct but not directly testable via data-testid.

critical_code_review_comments: BlessedPage.jsx renders both mobile and desktop layouts in the DOM simultaneously (responsive CSS toggles visibility). This means screen readers and DOM-order tests must use visibility-aware queries. The visible layout in each viewport DOES have CRAFT before CLAIM YOURS so the rule is satisfied, but consider a CSS-only approach or single conditional render to reduce DOM duplication.
BamburghPage.jsx gallery section has no data-testid — the SITEWIDE ORDER RULE should be testable via data-testid for every product page to enable consistent automated regression testing.
